in_sanskrit.name: कार्थेक
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who performs (kartavyam) the duty (kartavy) that is desired (kartukam) by the heart (kartukaam), or the one who is skilled in performing (kartsna) all tasks (kartsna)

in_hindi.name: कार्थीक
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who performs (kartavy) the duty (kartavy) that is desired (kartukam) by the heart (kartukaam), or the one who is the lord (kartavish) of performing (kartu) tasks (kartu)

in_tamil.name: கார்த்தீக
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who does not leave (karthavillaiye) his duty (karthu) and one who is absorbed (karthaiveye) in it, or the lord (karthar)

in_telugu.name: కార్థీక
in_telugu.long_meaning: Lord (kedaru) of performing (kartu) duties (kartu), or the one who is skilled (kedopa) in performing (kartu)

in_marathi.name: Kartheek
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of agriculture
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kartheek हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kartheek is derived from the Tamil word ‘Karttika’, which refers to the Karthikai star in the Hindu lunisolar calendar. It is believed that Lord Murugan, also known as Kartikeya, was born on this star. Kartheek is a name that signifies the god of agriculture and is often given to boys born during the Karthikai month.

It is believed that Lord Murugan, also known as Kartikeya, was born on this star. Kartheek is a name that signifies the god of agriculture and is often given to boys born during the Karthikai month.
